notes: Faster, cancellable updates — the download no longer gets stuck when the Cloudflare CDN or a corporate antivirus trickle-feeds the connection. Per-read socket timeout dropped to 3 seconds, a 10-second 'less than 1 MB/10 s' stall watchdog aborts a slow stream automatically, and the download now retries up to three times before surfacing an error. New Cancel button on the progress bar lets you abort cleanly at any time before the point of no return; cancel also deletes the partial staged file. Keeps the 1.1.2 updater hardening (Python re-entry guard, filesystem lockfile, start /B relaunch, no DETACHED_PROCESS mixing), the three AI-first features (live triage, battery coach, game and heavy-app narrator with full Dospara GALLERIA roster), non-intrusive daemons (fullscreen suppression and CPU-busy back-off), the first-run help coachmark, the eleven XSS fixes, and the preserved-user-work dialog copy.
